archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) infused with Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury)

layout.spacing: Generous spacing system using p-8, p-12, py-24 for sections to create an elegant breathing room.
layout.grid: Bento-style or wide asymmetric grids. Mobile-first grid-cols-1, scaling to md:grid-cols-2 and lg:grid-cols-3.

buttons.primary: bg-[#8B1A00] text-[#FAF8F0] rounded-none px-6 py-3 transition-colors hover:bg-[#A62000] font-medium tracking-wide flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: border-2 border-[#D4AF37] text-[#8B1A00] rounded-none px-6 py-3 transition-colors hover:bg-[#D4AF37]/10 font-medium tracking-wide flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.badge: bg-[#D4AF37] text-[#8B1A00] text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1 uppercase tracking-widest rounded-full

cards.book: bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#D4AF37]/20 p-6 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(139,26,0,0.05)] flex flex-col items-start gap-4 transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1
cards.author: bg-[#FAF8F0] border-l-4 border-[#8B1A00] p-6 shadow-sm

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#FAF8F0]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#D4AF37]/20 py-4 px-6 flex justify-between items-center

hero_bg.alt: Warm illuminated open book pages for abstract hero background

icons.usage: Use WhatsApp icon for order CTA, BookOpen icon for Free Excerpt CTA, Globe for language switch.

interactions.hover_states: Buttons shift background and borders; book cards elevate slightly on hover (-translate-y-1).
interactions.animations: Subtle fade-in-up for catalog items using framer-motion (y: 20 -> 0, opacity: 0 -> 1).

pages_and_sections.name: Header
pages_and_sections.features: Logo 'ZOE & REHOBOTH', 'Sponsored By Grace' Badge, Navigation, Language Switcher (FR/EN).

pages_and_sections.name: Hero
pages_and_sections.features: Large Slogan, CTA to Catalog, Abstract warm background overlay (bg-[#FAF8F0]/80).

pages_and_sections.name: Catalogue (5 Livres)
pages_and_sections.features: Grid of 5 books. Each book shows: Title, Cover placeholder, Price (FCFA). Actions: 'Commander via WhatsApp' (Primary) and 'Extrait Gratuit' (Secondary).

pages_and_sections.name: Auteurs
pages_and_sections.features: Biographies for Lewis Ekra and Vogel Deza. Side-by-side bento layout or stacked alternating layout.

pages_and_sections.name: Agenda / Dédicaces
pages_and_sections.features: List of upcoming events and signings. Minimalist date blocks (Day/Month).

pages_and_sections.name: Réseau de Distribution
pages_and_sections.features: Côte d'Ivoire, Togo, France highlighted with map pins or simple elegant list.

pages_and_sections.name: Footer
pages_and_sections.features: WhatsApp contacts (+225 07 59 49 31 18), Social links, Integrated Facebook Video section just above the footer.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for page structure, applying the defined Sardonyx (#8B1A00), Gold (#D4AF37) and Off-White (#FAF8F0) colors.
Ensure the hero image uses a gradient or solid color overlay to maintain high text contrast.
WhatsApp buttons must strictly use the #8B1A00 background and off-white text to fit the brand, avoiding default green.
Language switcher should update text content seamlessly (mock the translation dictionary).
Incorporate 'data-testid' on all buttons and interactive elements.
Setup the React application structure focusing on a single long scrolling landing page.
